title: Trump administration again denies entry visas to Palestinian officials ahead of UN general assembly
summary: For the second year in a row, the administration has barred the Palestinian delegation from US travel for the forum. The state department said in a statement the Palestinian Authority (PA) and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) had "failed to live up to their commitments", accusing the groups of "taking actions to internationalize the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict including through the International Criminal Court (ICC) and International Court of Justice (ICJ)" and of "glorifying terrorism" among other allegations. The US state department said on Wednesday that it had again denied entry visas to Palestinian officials ahead next week's United Nations general assembly gathering in New York .

title: YouTube star Ms Rachel to match Macklemore's $1m Palestine aid donation
summary: Educator talks of 'moral obligation' and urges 'every wealthy white celebrity' to make similar donation YouTube star Ms Rachel has said she is matching rapper Macklemore's $1m donation to organizations supporting Palestinians, calling on other public figures to follow suit. Macklemore, who was fired as the opening act on Ed Sheeran's tour after saying "Free Palestine" on stage at New Jersey's MetLife Stadium, pledged to donate the entirety of his earnings from Sheeran's tour to several organizations focused on the Palestinian people.
